verdict.rationale: Box's developer site says you can embed a secure, expiring preview of files stored in Box with in-context annotation, which covers the embeddable-preview part of the story. That support rests on a single marketing line, and nothing in the evidence covers thumbnails. Missing for 10: a thumbnail API/endpoint, documentation of supported preview formats, the API mechanics for generating preview/embed URLs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
